seo.title: What Do We Wear? 🧥👢 Clothes for Kids | Weather Guessing Game | Unique Kiddo
seo.description:
Snowy, rainy, windy or sunny, what do we wear? 🤔 Look at the two clues, think, and shout the answer with Kiddo!

A quick clothes and weather guessing game for kids. Children learn 4 clothes names:
🧥 Coat
👢 Rain Boots
🧣 Scarf
🩱 Swimsuit

Each round has think time so kids can guess, and a "say it with me" pause to practise new English words. Great for toddlers, preschool and kindergarten (ages 2–6).

⭐ Subscribe to Unique Kiddo for more fun learning games: animals, jobs, vehicles, letters and more!

Voice: Kokoro TTS (Apache 2.0) · Emoji art: Noto Emoji (Apache 2.0)
